My approach

Strategy first. Practical AI second.

New AI tools appear every day. For most business owners, the challenge is not finding another tool. It is knowing which tools to use, how to use them, and how they fit into a real marketing strategy.

That is where I help. My focus is not on using AI just because it is new. My focus is on using the right tools and strategies to help you get noticed, generate leads, win customers, and grow your business.

I translate complex marketing choices into a clear, focused plan that fits the realities of your business.
